metadata.title: Nvidia Stock Is Back Down  at $200. What History Suggests Is the Floor.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nvidia Stock Is Back Down at $200. What History Suggests Is the Floor.
Nvidia stock is at levels it hasn’t seen in three months. But the chip company’s recent record suggests it might be bottoming out soon.
